description: This Java class 'JwtAuthenticationFactory' provides a factory for creating and managing JWT-related security components such as validators, public key providers, and authorization providers within the Eclipse Ditto gateway security context.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating JWT authentication components like validators, key providers, and authorization providers in the Eclipse Ditto platform.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of JwtAuthenticationFactory with provided OAuth config, cache config, and HTTP client facade.

methods.name: getJwtValidator
methods.description: Returns a JwtValidator instance, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getPublicKeyProvider
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the PublicKeyProvider used for JWT validation.

methods.name: getJwtSubjectIssuersConfig
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JwtSubjectIssuersConfig based on OAuth configuration.

methods.name: newJwtAuthenticationResultProvider
methods.description: Creates and returns a new JwtAuthenticationResultProvider, used for obtaining authentication results.
